name: F09_8
notes: Stromkirk Bloodthief. Printed: 'At the beginning of your end step, if an opponent lost life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target Vampire you control.' Losing ONE life is enough: seat 0's Skeleton Archer enters and deals 1 damage to seat 1 (19), the only life lost this turn. At seat 0's end step the Bloodthief (the only Vampire seat 0 controls, so the target is forced) gets one +1/+1 counter.
